subtitle: "From gross natural ecosystem loss to the consumption-attributed footprint"

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/setup.R")
```

All figures sum over the `r length(valid_iso3)` producing countries that pass the
[data checks](coverage.qmd).

## From loss to footprint

Three steps narrow the observed loss down to the footprint: gross natural loss
(*unconstrained*), the part that coincides with cropland expansion in the same cell
(*agriculture-constrained*), and finally the share of it that is linked to German
final demand (*BF-NEE*).

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.6
cascade <- global_period %>%
  select(period,
         `Unconstrained natural loss` = loss_unconstrained_km2,
         `Agricultural expansion` = agri_gain_km2,
         `Agriculture-constrained loss` = loss_constrained_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "measure", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Unconstrained natural loss",
                                              "Agricultural expansion",
                                              "Agriculture-constrained loss")))

p <- ggplot(cascade, aes(period, km2, fill = measure,
                         text = paste0(measure, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2)))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = measure_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(title = "Natural ecosystem loss and agricultural expansion",
       subtitle = "Sum over all valid producing countries",
       x = NULL, y = "Area (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.8
p <- ggplot(global_period, aes(period, share_attributed, group = 1,
                               text = paste0(period, ": ", fmt_pct(share_attributed)))) +
  geom_line(colour = bf_brand$primary) +
  geom_point(colour = bf_brand$primary, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_pct, limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "Share of natural loss that coincides with agricultural expansion",
       subtitle = "Agriculture-constrained loss / unconstrained loss",
       x = NULL, y = NULL)

bf_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr has_pasture
#| fig-height: 4.4
basis <- global_period %>%
  select(period,
         `Cropland` = loss_cropland_km2,
         `Intensive pasture` = loss_pasture_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "basis", values_to = "km2") %>%
  group_by(period) %>% mutate(share = km2 / sum(km2)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basis = factor(basis, levels = names(basis_colors)))

p <- ggplot(basis, aes(period, km2, fill = basis,
                       text = paste0(basis, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2),
                                     " (", fmt_pct(share), ")"))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = basis_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Agriculture-constrained loss by land use",
       subtitle = "Split per grid cell by the expansion of cropland vs. intensive pasture",
       x = NULL, y = "Area (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## BF-NEE over time

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.2
p <- ggplot(global_period, aes(period, bfnee_km2, group = 1,
                               text = paste0(period, ": ", fmt_km2(bfnee_km2),
                                             "<br>", n_countries, " countries"))) +
  geom_area(fill = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]], alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line(colour = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]]) +
  geom_point(colour = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]], size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE: loss attributed to German final demand",
       subtitle = "Sum over all valid producing countries",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

### By ecosystem group

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.8
eco_period <- ce %>%
  group_by(period, eco_group) %>%
  summarise(bfnee_km2 = sum(bfnee_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  mutate(share = bfnee_km2 / sum(bfnee_km2)) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(eco_period, aes(period, bfnee_km2, fill = eco_group,
                            text = paste0(eco_group, "<br>", period, ": ",
                                          fmt_km2(bfnee_km2), " (", fmt_pct(share), ")"))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eco_group_colors, name = NULL, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE by ecosystem group",
       subtitle = "Ecosystem-specific footprints add up to the total",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

More detail on the [Ecosystems](ecosystems.qmd) page.

## Effect of the agricultural constraint

How much smaller is BF-NEE when only loss linked to agricultural expansion is
attributed, compared with attributing all natural loss?

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4
comp <- global_period %>%
  select(period, `BF-NEE (constrained)` = bfnee_km2,
         `Without constraint` = bfnee_unconstrained_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "variant", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, levels = c("Without constraint", "BF-NEE (constrained)")))

p <- ggplot(comp, aes(period, km2, fill = variant,
                      text = paste0(variant, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2)))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Without constraint" = bf_ink$other,
                               "BF-NEE (constrained)" = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]]),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE with and without the agricultural-expansion constraint",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## Table

```{r}
global_period %>%
  transmute(Period = period, Countries = n_countries,
            `Unconstrained loss (km²)` = round(loss_unconstrained_km2),
            `Agricultural expansion (km²)` = round(agri_gain_km2),
            `Constrained loss (km²)` = round(loss_constrained_km2),
            `Share attributed` = round(share_attributed, 3),
            `BF-NEE (km²)` = round(bfnee_km2, 1),
            `BF-NEE without constraint (km²)` = round(bfnee_unconstrained_km2, 1)) %>%
  bf_table(page_length = 4)
```
